headline: UNCW top the table unbeaten
dek: UNCW have lost three times all season, none of them in a table match, and conceded fifteen goals across everything they have played. Theirs is the only CAA match still to come.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: The table's leader does not lead the chart: UNCW have scored 28 goals in all matches and conceded fifteen, a lead built on what they keep out.

wire.line: UNCW, unbeaten in the table, are the only CAA side with a match still to play.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Eight matches, all dated in August, have passed with no result published, and none of them involves a North division side.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: College of Charleston have won ten matches in all, more than either Elon or Stony Brook, who both sit above them in the table.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fifteen different players have scored for Elon.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Milo Risenhoover has kept seven shutouts in Hofstra's goal.

last_match.line: UNCW followed their home defeat to College of Charleston with a clean sheet.

next_match.line: Both of UNCW's defeats outside the conference came away from home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
